editorial:
Imagine trying to start your life over after prison, only to get pulled into a dangerous game. You meet Connor, a guy just trying to stay low and work at a library, and Marilyn, a wealthy woman who seems bored with her perfect life. What starts as a simple crush quickly turns into a wild, steamy affair. The vibe is tense from the start because you can tell these two are playing with fire. It is not just a love story; it is a game of cat and mouse where you never quite know who is lying or who is actually in control of the situation.

The acting is great and keeps you guessing until the very end. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the twists make it worth the wait. If you love movies that mess with your head, you will enjoy this one.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Marilyn was manipulating Connor the whole time. She didn't actually love him; she just wanted him to kill her husband so she could get the money. In the end, Connor realizes he is just a pawn in her game. He tries to get away, but the trap is already set. He ends up being the fall guy for the crime, proving that Marilyn was the real villain all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers with a big twist.
